title: Endpoint Surface Contracts and Launch Gatebook for Hosted Inference
creator: Ruth Sanchez
description: This ticket consolidates the endpoint-level product contracts for the hosted inference surface (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank) and defines the gatebook for launch. The goal is to publish clear API contracts, acceptance criteria, operational SLOs, and an executable launch checklist so engineering, SDK, and Docs can align on behavior, error handling, and observability before GA.
goals: Define precise API surface contracts for chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank endpoints (inputs, outputs, streaming behavior, error semantics).
Establish acceptance criteria and automated tests that validate contract conformance across model variants.
Create a launch gatebook with pre-launch, launch-day, and post-launch checkpoints for engineering, docs, SDKs, and support.
Lock SLOs and monitoring playbooks to enable immediate incident response and rollback paths during launch.
Minimize customer migration work by providing clear compatibility notes and client-side examples.
non_goals: Designing new model training or tuning pipelines.
Specifying private / on-prem deployment contracts (handled in private repo).
Implementing Dedicated capacity autoscaling behaviors (separate Dedicated roadmap).
success_metrics: Latency: 95th percentile per-token latency meets runtime-1.20 SLO for default model at target QPS.
Availability: < 0.1% request error rate in the first 30 days post-launch for hosted endpoints.
Adoption: 30% of active trial orgs adopt hosted endpoints within 60 days of GA.
Docs & SDK: Official SDKs contain canonical examples for chat/streaming/function-calls and embeddings with code snippets in three languages.
requirements: Canonical request/response shapes for each endpoint documented and machine-validated via test harness.
Streaming APIs: chat and completions must support chunked token streaming with reconnect semantics documented.
Function/tool-calling contract: deterministic invocation signals and structured output schema for downstream callers.
Embeddings: vector size, distance metric, normalization recommendations, and stable hashing for caching must be published.
Rerank: stable scoring contract, tie-breaking rules, and scoring scale documented (0-1 float normalized).
Rate limiting and quotas: per-org and per-token quotas defined with deterministic 429 behavior and useful retry-after headers.
Error taxonomy: standardize error codes for client errors (4xx), rate/quota (429), transient infra errors (5xx) with guidance on retries and backoff.
Model variants: explicit mapping between catalog model id, capability tier, and fallback variant for overload conditions.
Observability hooks: per-route spans, token-level cost attribution, request IDs surfaced to clients and in logs.
Security: KMS encryption for customer payloads at rest (hosted) and audit logging enabled; must pass security review prior to GA.
api_surface_contracts: Chat endpoint (POST /v1/chat): body: messages[], temperature, top_k/top_p, stream boolean; response: choices[] with delta streaming for content; deterministic role and name fields; conversation_id optional header for KV caching.

Completions endpoint (POST /v1/completions): supports prompt string | structured prompt blocks, max_tokens, stop sequences, and streaming; chunked streaming must include token index metadata for alignment with token-costing and latency SLOs.

Embeddings endpoint (POST /v1/embeddings): accepts text[] or batch payloads; response: embeddings[] with vector_length, model_id, and stable_checksum fields; document-level metadata passthrough preserved.

Rerank endpoint (POST /v1/rerank): payload includes query and candidate_list; response includes ranking_scores[] and optional reasons[] strings for explainability; score normalization rules must be applied on server-side.
Common headers: x-request-id required for tracing, x-org-id for billing, Authorization bearer token; streaming connections must support reconnect with last_event_id semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Automated contract tests pass end-to-end against staging for each endpoint and model variant (smoke + fuzz tests).
SDKs (JS, Python, Go) include examples for streaming chat + resumable reconnects, function-calling, embeddings batching, and rerank usage.
Docs include explicit migration notes comparing previous endpoints and the new contract (breaking changes called out).
Load tests: system sustained QPS for target workload with < 1% 5xx errors and latency within defined SLOs during soak tests.
Security review sign-off recorded and vulnerabilities remediated or documented with mitigations.
Observability: per-route dashboards created in Console with token cost, p50/p95 latency, error rates, and top error classes.
Release toggles: feature flags exist to disable streaming and to force synchronous behavior for customer troubleshooting.
scope_changes: Initial proposal included server-side generated deterministic embeddings hashing; deferred to post-GA to reduce delivery risk—will ship simple stable_checksum instead.
Early design proposed per-token billing meter granularity for rerank; reverted to per-request billing with cost-estimate headers for launch.
Function-calling: only JSON-schema-first (structured tool calls) will be enforced at GA; arbitrary tool-call heuristics deferred.
rollout_checklist: - Finalize API contract doc and publish to /docs/api/hosted-endpoints (owner: Docs).
- Merge contract tests and add to CI gating (owner: ENG-infra).
- Security review completed with remediation plan (owner: Security).
- Create per-endpoint SLO dashboards and alerting (owner: Observability).
- SDK PRs merged and packaged for release (owners: SDK teams).
- Deploy runtime change behind canary for 5% traffic; monitor error rate and latency for 30m (owner: Serving).
- Open dedicated Slack channel and incident runbook visible to on-call (owner: On-call).
- Enable quota guardrails and synthetic traffic to validate throttling paths (owner: RateLimit).
- Docs & changelog published with code samples and migration guidance (owner: Docs).
- Daily triage of high-severity errors and regression checks; roll back if availability > SLA breach threshold (owner: SRE/PM).
- Collect customer feedback from trials and surface urgent issues to triage board (owner: Solutions).
- Run automated contract fuzzing across a larger sample of customer prompts (owner: QA).
post_launch_monitoring: Top-line metrics: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, 429 rate, token consumption per-organization.
Anomaly detection: automated alerts for sudden increases in error classes or cost spikes tied to single orgs.
Regression tests: nightly contract checks across each catalog model and most common prompt shapes.
Customer signals: top N support tickets tagged 'hosted-endpoint' and NPS feedback from pilot accounts aggregated to PM dashboard.
rollout_risks_mitigation: Risk: Streaming reconnection edge-cases cause duplicated tokens for some clients. Mitigation: document idempotency markers and provide client helpers in SDKs for deduping.
Risk: Unexpected 429s during bursty workloads. Mitigation: expose retry-after and suggested backoff headers; provide sample backoff code in docs.
Risk: Model fallback changes quality for sensitive prompts. Mitigation: conservative fallback policy (same family) and quality regression alerting tied to eval prompt sets.
notes: Design/Eng alignment meeting 2026-03-11: agreed to narrow scope on embeddings hashing and rerank billing for GA.
Legal requested clearer TOU language around model outputs; Docs owner to coordinate updated examples with legal by 2026-03-16.
PM note: consider a guided migration tool for customers using legacy endpoints in next cycle (post-GA).
